issue_description: Surveyor has requested approval to change mobile device
resolution_steps: Login to portal → Configurations → User Device Details → Approve request

issue_description: Certain crops are not visible in mobile app
resolution_steps: 1. Sync master data in app 2. Portal → Configurations → Master Data → Crop Registry Configuration → Check crop active status.

issue_description: Surveyor cannot login
resolution_steps: Ensure Aadhaar, Mobile & Email verification are completed.

issue_description: Need to update existing surveyor info
resolution_steps: Portal → Survey Task Management → Add Crop Surveyors → Edit → Save

issue_description: App shows connection failure
resolution_steps: Check internet → Switch network → Retry

issue_title: OTP received but ID/password not received
issue_description: User gets OTP but no credentials SMS
resolution_steps: Verify mobile → Check spam → Resend credentials

issue_description: Login error
resolution_steps: Confirm credentials → Reset password

issue_description: Email verification failing
resolution_steps: Use default OTP 123456 → Check spam → Verify email

issue_description: Error: Your Device is not compatible with this version
resolution_steps: Application supports Android version 10 and above only.

issue_description: Some options not visible
resolution_steps: Master Data Sync → Restart app → Clear cache

issue_description: Only limited villages visible
resolution_steps: Report to state technical team for mapping update

issue_description: Crop missing or language issue
resolution_steps: Configuration → Crops → Search (Hindi) → Add/Update → Sync

issue_description: Error 503 displayed
resolution_steps: Maintenance activity is ongoing (Tuesdays & Thursdays 6–8 PM); Try after some time.

issue_description: Data not visible in reports
resolution_steps: Surveys done today will be available in tomorrow's reports. Wait next day → If missing escalate to the team.(

issue_description: Error 429: Multiple requests sent from device/portal
resolution_steps: contact admin for further action

issue_description: Error: Connection reset while using app
resolution_steps: Close the app and login again

issue_description: Internal server error while using app
resolution_steps: Surveyor: Retry after some time. District/State: Verify surveyor is active on portal; if active, escalate to technical team

issue_description: Downloading master data taking too much time
resolution_steps: Ensure stable and strong internet connection before downloading master data

issue_description: Error 404 displayed in app
resolution_steps: Update to latest app version from Play Store; if already updated, click refresh in the app.

issue_description: Warning: Security risk detected
resolution_steps: Disable Developer Options from phone settings and restart app

issue_description: App stuck on loading screen during login
resolution_steps: Ensure proper internet connectivity and retry login

issue_title: Surveys not uploading in pending tab
issue_description: Surveys stuck in upload pending tab
resolution_steps: Open each survey → Click Edit → Save again and upload

issue_description: Error: You are using incorrect version of the app
resolution_steps: Surveyor: Update app from Play Store. State: In state portal > Configurations> Check 'version_code' and 'allowed_previous_versions'

issue_title: App downloaded from unknown source error
issue_description: Error: Looks like the app is not downloaded from the trusted source.
resolution_steps: Open DCS app and click refresh; ensure app installed from the Play Store.

issue_description: Error related to uploading more than 3 images
resolution_steps: Inform development team; respond to surveyor that issue is under review
